subject: Production Latency Spike — Cross-region Handoff Observed
messages:
From: Matt Cole <matt.cole@vitahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Support Team <support@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT

Hi Grace / Support,

We started seeing a large jump in generation latency around 08:45 PDT this morning. Our p95 has gone from ~120ms to ~1.1s and p99 is spiking >1.8s. Error rate is still low but throughput is impacted — timeouts on our side for some interactive flows. This is across all eu-based endpoints (eu1.redwood.ai).

Attached is a short trace we captured from our side and a screenshot of the latency dashboard (perf_trace_20280520.png). Can you confirm whether this is a known issue or if anything changed in routing? We have a high-traffic campaign and this is user-facing.

Thanks,
Matt Cole
Sr. Platform Engineer | VitaHealth

Attachments: perf_trace_20280520.png, perf_logs.zip

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Cole <matt.cole@vitahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Support Team <support@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT

Matt — thanks for the heads up and for the traces. We see the same p95/p99 jump in our EU edge fleet around 08:44 PDT.

Immediate plan: I'm escalating to infra and networking now (looping Jonas and Monica). We'll prioritize a mitigation (pin traffic to eu-edge or apply a routing fix).

Can you confirm whether your requests include a region hint or a region-specific host? Also sharing your HubSpot account id would help correlate logs on our side (if you prefer, reply off-thread).

I will update within 30 minutes with an initial triage. Apologies for the impact.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Support Team <support@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT

Quick update — I've pulled the edge routing logs and there is a surge of EU-origin requests that were matched to a fallback policy causing them to be routed via our us-west edge cluster between 08:43:30 and 08:46:10. RTT to us-west from EU clients explains the ~900ms delta we're seeing on p95.

Preliminary cause: a recently deployed routing matcher meant to handle cross-region handoffs used an overly-broad prefix rule (route-match: "+/eu/* -> fallback-us"), and a specific CIDR mask change during last night's push made some EU egress IPs fall into the fallback set. I'm attaching a small diff of the routing config and the matched logs (routing-config-diff.txt).

Immediate mitigation options:
- Hotfix the matcher to tighten the prefix mask (low risk, fast)
- Force a rollback to previous routing rules (safe, slightly slower)
- Pin VitaHealth traffic to eu-edge via a temporary routing override (fast but manual)

I'm running the hotfix in a canary now for a subset of connections to validate.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: routing-config-diff.txt

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Cole <matt.cole@vitahealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT

Matt — status update: Jonas identified a mis-scope in routing rules that caused a subset of EU traffic to be handed to our us-west fleet, which matches the timing you reported. Jonas is rolling a targeted hotfix to tighten the prefix.

Short-term mitigation: we've applied a temporary routing override for VitaHealth's account (pinned to eu-edge) while we validate the configuration change. That should bring your p95 back down within the next 5–10 minutes.

We will follow up with a postmortem and the config diff. For now, can you watch the next 15 minutes and let me know if you still see elevated latency?

— Grace

From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@vitahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT

Thanks — we see p95 coming down to ~140ms within 7 minutes after the override. p99 is still a bit elevated (~450ms) but much better. We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Can you share the postmortem once available and an ETA for a full fix (not just the override)? We need to communicate to execs and the SRE team here.

— Sofia
Sofia Ruiz
Ops Lead | VitaHealth

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Matt Cole <matt.cole@vitahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT — follow-up

Folks — follow-up on the root cause and next steps:

Root cause summary (short): a routing matcher change deployed in the 2028-05-19 midnight push loosened the CIDR mask for eu->fallback rules. Some EU egress IPs matched the fallback rule and were sent to the us-west edge, increasing RTT and causing p95/p99 regressions for EU customers.

Work completed:
- Hotfix validated in canary and promoted across the fleet (rolled at 03:10 UTC 2028-05-21).
- VitaHealth pinned to eu-edge until the config change is fully propagated.
- Telemetry alert thresholds adjusted to detect similar cross-region handoffs earlier.

Planned work (this week):
- Config regression test added to pre-deploy pipeline (INF-2391)
- Postmortem draft and internal RCA (by EOD Wed)
- Customer-facing postmortem and goodwill offer: 10% service credit for impacted window (draft for Grace/Marcus to review)

Attachments: support_ticket_78421.pdf (incident ticket export).

— Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Matt Cole <matt.cole@vitahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ruiz <sofia@vitahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in hosted API latency (p95/p99) since 08:45 PDT — follow-up

Appreciate the rapid response and the follow-up detail. The team here has reviewed the proposed 10% credit and that's fine. We'll want a short timeline for the regression-test rollout (INF-2391) so our SREs can align on change windows.

Two asks:
- Please copy our oncall (oncall@vitahealth.com) into the final postmortem email so they have the artifact.
- Can you confirm whether any other customers were impacted in EU (we saw a handful of peers in our monitoring) — if yes, please share the list or confirm outreach plan.

Thanks — Matt
